leanYears.name: The Lean Years
leanYears.flavor: The granary door swings on an empty room.
leanYears.note: Every one of your cities feeds itself worse while this sits in a chair.

idleHands.name: The Idle Hands
idleHands.flavor: The scaffold stands; nobody climbs it.
idleHands.note: Every one of your cities builds more slowly while this sits in a chair.

debasedCoin.name: The Debased Coin
debasedCoin.flavor: The same face, and less silver behind it.
debasedCoin.note: Every one of your cities pays the treasury less while this sits in a chair.

closedSchools.name: The Closed Schools
closedSchools.flavor: The benches are swept and the door is barred.
closedSchools.note: Every one of your cities learns more slowly while this sits in a chair.

silentChoirs.name: The Silent Choirs
silentChoirs.flavor: A hall built for singing, and nobody sings.
silentChoirs.note: Every one of your cities makes less culture while this sits in a chair.

doubtingFlock.name: The Doubting Flock
doubtingFlock.flavor: They keep the feast days and forget the reason.
doubtingFlock.note: Your holy site presses its faith on the world more weakly while this sits in a chair.

restlessCities.name: The Restless Cities
restlessCities.flavor: The crowd has not decided what it wants yet.
restlessCities.note: Every one of your cities is less content while this sits in a chair.

thinRanks.name: The Thin Ranks
thinRanks.flavor: The line is as long as it was, and thinner.
thinRanks.note: Every one of your units fights worse, attacking and defending alike, while this sits in a chair.

deserters.name: The Deserters
deserters.flavor: Paid twice over, and half of them gone by morning.
deserters.note: Every unit you already pay for costs the treasury more each turn while this sits in a chair.

brokenLevies.name: The Broken Levies
brokenLevies.flavor: The muster roll is read out to an empty square.
brokenLevies.note: Every one of your cities builds soldiers more slowly while this sits in a chair.

shortDraft.name: The Short Draft
shortDraft.flavor: The council meets, and one chair is empty.
shortDraft.note: Your Order drafts deal you one card fewer while this sits in a chair.

heavyWrit.name: The Heavy Writ
heavyWrit.flavor: Every clerk holds a seal, and none of them the pen.
heavyWrit.note: Your realm may govern less than it could while this sits in a chair.
